message.content: This is the final review. c1 and c2 are decisively rebutted by the end-to-end probe (relative error 2.02e-7 vs 1e-4 tolerance, finite output) and the bit-exact tl.log comparison. c3 remains inconclusive only because the probe variant hit a Triton indexing limitation, but the c1 end-to-end result already shows the mask semantics produce the correct pivot sequence on the fixed workload — a mask bug would have corrupted the output far beyond 2e-7. No new material in-scope claims are warranted.
